1.title: Ang Lumang Orasan
previously_on: 1898. The last watchmakers of Santa Cruz seal something inside a pocket watch.
Every clock in the Reyes shop has been stopped at 4:17 ever since.
Tonight, the seal begins to fail.
next_time_on: A sacristan who heard too much.
A lender's envelope that says the shop is next.
And a watch that runs backward in a dead man's pocket.
